basics.name: Tingting Du
basics.label: Computer Science and Mathematics undergraduate at UW–Madison
basics.summary: Robot learning researcher working on trimanual manipulation, human–robot collaboration, Vision-Language-Action models, and LLM reasoning.

highlights: Learning from demonstration for trimanual human–robot team manipulation.
Wired a unified emergency-stop interlock tying all three arms to a single safety circuit.
Developed a multi-layer shared projector bridging 2D and 3D representations in VLA models (NeurIPS 2026).
Developed XGenAct, a geometry-enhanced world action model (under review).
Deployed and evaluated both systems on real-world manipulation with a UFACTORY xArm.

work.company: DM² Lab, University of Notre Dame
highlights: Developed a student modeling approach for question generation (ACL 2025).

work.position: Situated Language Use and Convention Formation
highlights: Analyzed ad-hoc convention formation in a large 3D-environment dialogue corpus.
